trade_finder.how: Each suggestion comes from the Trade Finder logic: one side has a real need (the offered players would raise its starting lineup) or, for a rebuilder, the deal fits its timeline; the two sides are within 10% in FantasyCalc market value; each team is read as a contender, retooling or rebuilder. Build the issue's hypothetical trades from these (a and b are the two managers; as/bs are already in issue wording, keep them as written so the values and the Load in trade calculator link work). Write the desk commentary yourself; do not invent assets or values.

Darkspaces.tagline: Commissioner, negotiator, and a 22.3-point bench player.
file: The type
A commissioner who competes, and a competitor who negotiates in public. Every roster move comes with an audience.
Signature move
Naming a price in the chat, then renegotiating it live. Swift for next year's 1st, Collins on the block, and Achane staying in the IR slot till next year.
Nemesis
The margin. A 23.2-point loss with a perfect lineup in Week 5, then a 0.56-point loss with Omar Cooper's 22.3 on the bench.
The desk is watching
Whether the block becomes a trade before the deadline, and a FAAB budget that is down to $104.

2026.headline: 2-4, the 1.02, and a loss by 0.56
story: The draft set the tone. Darkspaces cut the pick timer to a minute, loaded up on receivers, and handed nicknames to twenty-three of his own players, then spent the first waiver run buying a tight end he had not drafted for $101 and Singleton for $301 on top of it. That is $402 gone before the first Monday night, and the wallet is down to $104.

The pattern since is spend big, sell high, talk loudly. Deebo Samuel went to Snipe58 for a 2027 2nd, Colston Loveland went for Jake Ferguson, and Matthew Stafford went to the same buyer for two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB. Week 5 brought a perfect lineup that lost anyway, and Week 6 brought a 141.56 to 141.0 loss to YesChef23, with Tre Tucker leading at 26.7, 15.4 left on the bench, and Omar Cooper's 22.3 among the points sitting there.

The record is 2-4, down two spots to 11th. His MAXPF is 805.68, which is the 1.02, 53.9 points behind Snipe58 for the 1.01. The commissioner wrote the rule and watched the 1.01 slip away in a week he scored 141.0. The poll gave him two votes to keep it, and Snipe58 took the same number and the pick.
takes: Perfect process in Week 5, a bench decision in Week 6.
The negotiation is the content, and the roast is the encore.

Snipe58.tagline: The quiet buyer who just took the 1.01.
file: The type
A win-now buyer who pays with the future. Stays out of the chat and lets the transaction log do the talking.
Signature move
Quietly converting picks into veterans. Deebo Samuel cost a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson cost Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford cost two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB.
Nemesis
The scoring column. 649.78 points is the lowest total in the league.
The desk is watching
Whether the 1.01 turns into a seller's market, and whether Stafford ever scores again like Week 5.

2026.headline: 3-3, the 1.01, and the lowest points total in the league
story: Snipe58 does not post much, but the ledger is loud. He bought Deebo Samuel for a 2027 2nd, traded Loveland for Ferguson, and paid a 2028 2nd, a 2029 2nd and $100 of FAAB for Stafford. Each deal was a present-tense purchase funded with future capital.

Week 6 was an 89.08 to 83.34 loss to Hades9mm, the lowest-scoring game of the week, with Germie Bernard leading at 25.7 and 12.1 left on the bench. The record is 3-3, down three spots to 9th. His 638.52 points against are the fewest in the league, so the schedule has been kind.

The 751.78 MAXPF is the lowest in the league, and it makes him the 1.01 holder, 53.9 points ahead of Darkspaces. The poll gave him two votes, and the desk called seven points behind and closing. Justin Jefferson, Brock Purdy and Stafford are the roster's core. FAAB is $400.
takes: Buys the present, sells the future, and ended up with the first pick.
The lowest score in the league and the best seat in the draft.

StealingGas.tagline: The tank that keeps scoring perfect lineups.
file: The type
A self-declared tanker with a competitor's wallet. Announces the plan, then spends against it, and in Weeks 5 and 6 scored against it.
Signature move
The announcement-then-purchase combo: tank declared in Week 2, $99 on Stribling immediately, then $298 on Jaxson Dart.
Nemesis
The draft rule. Two perfect lineups in a row raised his MAXPF and slid him from the 1.03 to the 1.05.
The desk is watching
Whether he sells scorers before the deadline. He told the chat he may have no firsts by then, and FAAB is down to $98.

2026.headline: 3-3, the 1.05, and two perfect lineups in a row
story: StealingGas opened the year with the league's worst score at 83.32, repeated it with 77.18 in Week 2, and announced the tank. Then he spent $99 on a waiver dart, followed it with $298 on Jaxson Dart, and posted a perfect 152.42 lineup in Week 3. Weeks 5 and 6 brought two more: 202.54, then 180.64, each with nothing left on the bench.

Week 6 was a 105.82-point win over Sarge71 with Malik Nabers at 28.5 and Trevor Lawrence at 28.34, the QB of the week. He is 3-3, up two spots to 5th, with 829.6 points, fifth in the league. The perfect lineups raised his MAXPF to 915.88 and slid him to the 1.05. Week 6 moves were small: the Patriots defense in from free agency, Travis Hunter out.

The chat bits stay reliable. He asked Darkspaces whether his brain injury was new, said he is interested in the Swift sweepstakes, said he would trade for Drake Maye, admitted he may have no firsts come trade deadline, and in Week 6 praised Mahomes' leg for getting stronger every week. The desk keeps taking notes and the draft rule keeps taking points.
takes: Two perfect lineups, two drops in the draft order.
A tank with 180.64 on the scoreboard is a tank with a hobby.

Zygon.tagline: The IR Predictor. 5-1, and the formula keeps winning.
file: The type
The algorithm manager. Builds the roster around production, then lets the numbers run.
Signature move
Listing handcuffs on the block as a dare. Emmett Johnson and Blake Corum are posted with the line make me regret it when Walker tears his ACL.
Nemesis
The top of the MAXPF board. 1032.94 is 0.02 behind Hades9mm.
The desk is watching
Whether Zygon takes the highest MAXPF, and CMac91 in Week 7.

2026.headline: 5-1, first place, and 0.02 from the top MAXPF
story: Zygon is the league leader at 5-1 and the only team that barely touches the waiver wire. His FAAB spend is $7: $2 on Ollie Gordon and $5 on Jacoby Brissett. The team is built on Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Kenneth Walker and Patrick Mahomes and has the league's highest points total at 909.62.

Week 6 was a 122.8 to 90.72 win over fumbduckdumbfuck with Kenneth Walker at 27.9 and 14.24 left on the bench. Week 5 was the first loss, to C33DeezNutzz, after he asked the chat for food poisoning on Josh Allen. StealingGas posted a GIF of Mahomes dancing with Andy Reid and Walker this week and said the leg looks stronger every week.

He is 5-1 and holds the 1.11. His MAXPF is 1032.94, second in the league and 0.02 behind Hades9mm. FAAB is $493. The desk's view is the same as before: the formula is hard to write around, and the next step is the top MAXPF.
takes: The formula does not bid on anyone and does not stop winning.
Elite bit commitment: the nickname, the 4-0, the first loss, and the 5-1.

Hades9mm.tagline: The sleeper puss, 4-2, and the highest MAXPF in the league.
file: The type
A balanced, hand-built roster and a buyer's budget. Every one of his 23 picks was his own, which is the rarest thing in this league.
Signature move
Selling a star for depth. The London deal moved Drake London for Quentin Johnston, Cam Ward, TreVeyon Henderson and a 2027 3rd.
Nemesis
The bench. 16.4 left on it in Week 6 and 37.06 in Week 5.
The desk is watching
The league's highest MAXPF at 1032.96, the 1.12, and StealingGas in Week 7.

2026.headline: 4-2, third place, and the best ceiling in the league
story: Hades9mm drafted every one of his 23 picks himself, and the roster shows it: Jayden Daniels and Jared Goff at quarterback, Amon-Ra St. Brown and London at receiver, Derrick Henry and Cam Skattebo at running back, Kittle and Kelce at tight end. He started 3-0, lost to Zygon in Week 4 and Painty69 in Week 5, and won in Week 6.

Week 6 was an 89.08 to 83.34 win over Snipe58, the lowest-scoring game of the week, with Jayden Daniels at 21.0 and 16.4 left on the bench. He is 4-2, 3rd in the standings, with 832.5 points, third in the league. FAAB is $330, and he has not been spending it.

The files feud with Darkspaces is still his best content: four 1sts for Mendoza, Maye, Achane and Egbuka, followed by a threat to release the trade-talk logs. His 1032.96 MAXPF is the league's best by 0.02 over Zygon, and it makes the 1.12 his. The desk's view: the ceiling is real, and now he has to set the lineup.
takes: The best ceiling in the league, and the bench keeps the receipt.
Victory royal, still on paper.

Johnny4Skins.tagline: Dual-QB, dual-autopilot, and the winning streak ended.
file: The type
The league's most hands-off roster. Johnny4Skins drafted a few good players, then left the room and let the system finish the job.
Signature move
Not spending. $500 of FAAB intact, and the only moves are free ones.
Nemesis
CMac91, who beat him by 21.66 in Week 6 and ended the streak, and Zygon, who beat him by 70 in Week 1.
The desk is watching
Whether the autopilot recovers against YesChef23 in Week 7.

2026.headline: 4-2, second place, and a second loss
story: Johnny4Skins took Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson in the first two rounds, then went to dinner. The autopick drafted eighteen of his players, including Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf. Not a single human opinion went into any of them.

It worked for four straight weeks after the Week 1 loss to Zygon, including a 163.56 to 140.36 win over Darkspaces in Week 5. Week 6 ended it: a 127.72 to 106.06 loss to CMac91 with Isaiah Likely leading at 23.9, the TE of the week, and only 7.3 left on the bench.
He is 4-2, still second in the standings, with 838.62 points, second in the league. His $500 of FAAB is untouched and his 969.02 MAXPF holds the 1.10. Next up: YesChef23, who just won a game by 0.56.
takes: The robot spent nothing and finally lost.
A good autopick is still not a plan, but it is a pattern.

Sarge71.tagline: The engine without the cast, and the worst record in the league.
file: The type
A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
Signature move
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
Nemesis
The bench and the schedule. 45.5 left on it in Week 5 and 25.22 in Week 6.
The desk is watching
Whether the roster adds one real depth piece, and the 1.03.

2026.headline: 1-5, last place, and the 1.03
story: Sarge71 started 0-3, beat Painty69 by 1.34 in Week 4, then lost to Snipe58 in Week 5 and StealingGas in Week 6. The Week 6 loss was 180.64 to 74.82, the lowest score of the week, with Aaron Rodgers leading at 17.02 and 25.22 left on the bench.

The roster is Bijan Robinson and a supporting cast that scores on its own schedule. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 in Week 4 and Robinson has two MVP weeks. He cut Jaxson Dart, watched StealingGas bid $298 on him, and replaced him with Aaron Rodgers.

At 1-5 he is 12th in the standings. His 930.6 points against are the most in the league, and his 849.46 MAXPF holds the 1.03. FAAB is untouched at $500, and the more useful move is still a trade, which Sarge71 has not made.
takes: Sarge has the engine and a schedule that keeps hitting it.
The schedule is mean. The lineup is meaner.

2026.headline: 3-3, fourth place, and a bad Week 6
story: C33DeezNutzz opened with a 195.82, the highest score of Week 1, with Josh Allen providing 35.66, then lost to Hades9mm in Week 2, beat CMac91 in Week 3, lost to fumbduckdumbfuck in Week 4 and beat Zygon in Week 5, ending the unbeaten run.

Quiet is not the same as safe, but it is close.

2026.headline: Two wins in a row and a bench full of points
story: Painty69 took Jahmyr Gibbs at 1.01, then McCaffrey and Barkley back to back, and then stopped. The last real pick was in round 6, and the CPU made the remaining seventeen, tying him with Johnny4Skins at eighteen autopicks.

Weeks 5 and 6 were his first two wins. He beat Hades9mm 153.1 to 126.24 in Week 5 and C33DeezNutzz 111.52 to 95.46 in Week 6, with Christian McCaffrey at 30.7, the RB of the week. 40.58 stayed on the bench, including C.J. Stroud's 23.98 and Rachaad White's 15.7. The earlier losses were by 12.7, 32.3, 4.7 and 1.34.
He is 2-4, 10th in the standings, with 761.76 points. He did not say a word in the Week 5 or Week 6 chat, which fits. His 966.56 MAXPF is the fourth-highest in the league and the 1.09 is his.
takes: McCaffrey did the job. The bench kept the receipts.
Positive and kind, and still silent.

CMac91.tagline: The depth collector who ended the streak.

2026.headline: 3-3, up two spots, and the win that ended Johnny4Skins' streak
story: CMac91 asked in round 5 whether there were seriously 23 rounds, played through round 11, and let the robot finish the draft, which gave him twelve autopicks. The first-round pick was James Cook, followed by CeeDee Lamb at 2.02 and Bo Nix at 3.02.

Week 4 brought 183.42, the high score of the week. Week 5 brought 74.52, the lowest. Week 6 was a 127.72 to 106.06 win over Johnny4Skins with James Cook leading at 24.3 and 17.56 left on the bench, which ended Johnny4Skins' four-game winning streak.
At 3-3 he rose two spots to 6th. FAAB is a full $500 and the 1.08 is his. The desk's view is the same as before: the roster is fine and the lineup is the variable.
takes: Depth first, spending never, and a streak ended.
It works, until it does not.

He is 3-3, up two spots to 8th. FAAB is $449 and his 856.76 MAXPF holds the 1.04. His 685.88 points are the third-lowest in the league.

The restaurant is open, and the kitchen is quiet.

story: fumbduckdumbfuck was the desk's number one in Issue 1, and the roster still supports it: Brock Bowers at 1.12, Ashton Jeanty at 2.01, Jonathan Taylor at 3.01, with Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Dak Prescott behind them. He is 3-3 with 743.58 points.

paras: Zygon leads at 5-1. Johnny4Skins and Hades9mm are 4-2, six teams are at 3-3 (C33DeezNutzz, StealingGas, CMac91, fumbduckdumbfuck, YesChef23 and Snipe58), Painty69 and Darkspaces are 2-4, and Sarge71 is 1-5. The draft order by MAXPF now reads Snipe58 1.01, Darkspaces 1.02, Sarge71 1.03, YesChef23 1.04 and StealingGas 1.05.

Issue 6's poll went two votes each to Darkspaces and Snipe58, one to Someone else and none to YesChef23, and the 1.01 went to Snipe58. Next up: StealingGas and Hades9mm in the Match of the Week, Zygon against CMac91, Johnny4Skins against YesChef23, and a new poll below. Cast your vote, then go start somebody.

closer.label: The desk's last word
closer.text: Snipe58 took the 1.01 by losing. Darkspaces lost by 0.56 with a 22.3-point bench. StealingGas went perfect and fell a slot. The league keeps rewarding the wrong thing. The deadline will not care.
